[shr-00001] When the task is to 'look at' an object and the object is visible or accessible in its current location, then examine the object in place (e.g., 'examine <object>') instead of taking it unless the object is hidden or requires being picked up to be viewed.
[shr-00002] When an object is already visible and accessible, and repeated examination of its location yields no new information or environmental change, then stop examining the location and proceed to examine or interact with the object directly.
[shr-00008] When the task is to 'examine <object> with <tool>' and both the object and the tool are visible and accessible, then directly perform the action 'use <tool> on <object>' to fulfill the task requirement, without first using the tool alone or interacting with unrelated objects.
[shr-00021] When the task is to 'look at <object> with <tool>' and the object is not in the correct relative position (e.g., not under the desklamp), then first adjust the object's position to satisfy the spatial condition before applying the tool directly to the object.
[shr-00023] When the task is to 'look at <object> with <tool>' and the object is visible and accessible in a different location than the tool, then apply the tool directly to the object from the object's location (e.g., 'use <tool> on <object>') without first moving the object or the tool, provided the tool is accessible.
[shr-00026] When both the object and the tool are visible and accessible, and the object is already in the correct spatial position (e.g., under the desklamp), then directly apply the tool to the object (e.g., 'use <tool> on <object>') without activating the tool in isolation (e.g., 'use <tool>').
[shr-00040] When the tool requires activation (e.g., turning on) and the object is already visible and in the correct spatial position (e.g., 'under the desklamp'), then activate the tool as part of the direct application to the object (e.g., 'use desklamp on vase') instead of activating the tool in isolation.
## VERIFICATION CHECKLIST
[vc-00003] Before taking an object for the purpose of 'looking at' it, verify that the object is already visible and accessible in its current location. If so, examine it in place instead.
[vc-00004] Before performing any action to interact with an object for the purpose of 'looking at' it, verify that the object is both visible and accessible in its current location. If so, proceed to examine it in place instead of taking or moving it.
[vc-00005] Before examining or taking an object for the purpose of 'looking at' it, verify that the object is in the correct relative position as specified in the task (e.g., 'under the desklamp'). If the position is not correct, adjust the object's position or confirm that the task's spatial condition is satisfied.
[vc-00006] Before examining an object with a specified tool (e.g., 'with the desklamp'), verify that the tool is accessible and that using it on the object will yield the intended examination. If so, use the tool directly on the object instead of performing redundant or irrelevant actions.
[vc-00007] Before completing the task of 'examining an object with a tool', verify that the tool has been directly applied to the object (e.g., 'use <tool> on <object>'). If not, perform this action to fulfill the task's requirement.
[vc-00009] Before using a tool on an object for the purpose of 'examining with', verify that the tool is being applied directly to the correct object as specified in the task (e.g., 'use desklamp on bowl'). If not, adjust the action to ensure the tool is used on the correct object.
[vc-00010] After activating a tool for the purpose of 'examining an object with the tool', verify that the agent is at the location of the object and that the action 'use <tool> on <object>' is performed directly. If not, return to the object's location and apply the tool.
[vc-00011] Before using a tool for the purpose of 'examining an object with the tool', verify that the tool is not being used in isolation (e.g., 'use <tool>') without applying it to the object. If so, adjust the action to directly apply the tool to the object (e.g., 'use <tool> on <object>').
[vc-00012] Before using a tool for the purpose of 'examining an object with the tool', verify that the tool is not being used in isolation (e.g., 'use <tool>') without applying it to the object. If so, adjust the action to directly apply the tool to the object (e.g., 'use <tool> on <object>').
[vc-00013] Before using a tool for the purpose of 'examining an object with the tool', verify that the action is not 'use <tool>' in isolation. If so, adjust the action to 'use <tool> on <object>' immediately to avoid redundant activation of the tool.
[vc-00014] Before using a tool for the purpose of 'examining an object with the tool', verify that the action is 'use <tool> on <object>' and that the object matches the one specified in the task. If not, adjust the action to ensure the correct object is targeted.
[vc-00015] Before using a tool on an object for the purpose of 'examining with', verify that any required activation of the tool (e.g., turning it on) is performed as part of the direct application (e.g., 'use <tool> on <object>'). If the tool is being activated in isolation (e.g., 'use <tool>'), adjust the action to directly apply the tool to the object.
[vc-00016] Before using a tool for the purpose of 'examining an object with the tool', verify that the action is not 'use <tool>' in isolation and that the object is explicitly referenced in the action (e.g., 'use <tool> on <object>'). If the tool is being used in isolation, adjust the action to directly apply the tool to the object.
[vc-00017] Before using a tool for the purpose of 'examining an object with the tool', verify that the tool is not being repeatedly activated in isolation (e.g., 'use <tool>') without applying it to the object. If so, adjust the action to directly apply the tool to the object (e.g., 'use <tool> on <object>') and avoid redundant activations.
[vc-00018] Before using a tool on an object for the purpose of 'examining with', verify that the agent is at the same location as the object and that the action is 'use <tool> on <object>'. If not, move to the object's location and apply the tool directly to it.
[vc-00019] Before using a tool on an object for the purpose of 'examining with', verify that the agent is at the object's location. If not, move to the object's location before applying the tool to it.
[vc-00020] Before using a tool for the purpose of 'examining an object with the tool', verify that the action is 'use <tool> on <object>' and that the object is in the same location as the agent. If so, perform the action immediately to avoid redundant activation of the tool in isolation.
[vc-00022] Before using a tool repeatedly for the purpose of 'examining an object with the tool', verify that the tool is being applied directly to the object (e.g., 'use <tool> on <object>'). If the tool is being activated in isolation (e.g., 'use <tool>') multiple times without referencing the object, adjust the action to directly apply the tool to the object and avoid redundant activation.
[vc-00024] After retrieving an object for the purpose of 'looking at <object> with <tool>', verify that the object is placed in the correct spatial position relative to the tool (e.g., 'under the desklamp'). If not, adjust the object's position before applying the tool directly to it.
[vc-00025] Before using a tool for the purpose of 'examining an object with the tool', verify that the object is in the correct spatial position relative to the tool (e.g., 'under the desklamp'). If not, move the object to the correct position before applying the tool.
[vc-00027] Before using a tool on an object for the purpose of 'examining with', verify that the object being targeted matches the one specified in the task (e.g., 'laptop'). If not, adjust the action to ensure the correct object is used in the 'use <tool> on <object>' command.
[vc-00028] Before using a tool for the purpose of 'examining an object with the tool', verify that the object is visible and accessible and that the action is 'use <tool> on <object>', not 'use <tool>'. If the tool is being activated in isolation, adjust the action to directly apply the tool to the object.
[vc-00029] Before applying a tool to an object for the purpose of 'looking at <object> under <tool>', verify that the object is already in the correct spatial position (e.g., 'under the desklamp'). If the position is correct, proceed to apply the tool directly to the object without adjusting the object's position.
[vc-00030] Before using a tool for the purpose of 'looking at <object> under <tool>', verify that the action is 'use <tool> on <object>' and that the object is already in the correct spatial position (e.g., 'under the desklamp'). If the tool is being activated in isolation (e.g., 'use <tool>'), adjust the action to directly apply the tool to the object.
[vc-00031] Before completing the task of 'examining an object with a tool', verify that the action is 'use <tool> on <object>' and that the object is the one specified in the task. If the tool is being used in isolation (e.g., 'use <tool>'), adjust the action to directly apply the tool to the object.
[vc-00032] Before applying a tool to an object for the purpose of 'examining with', verify that the object is in the agent's inventory and the tool is accessible. If so, perform 'use <tool> on <object>' immediately to fulfill the task.
[vc-00033] Before using a tool for the purpose of 'examining an object with the tool', verify that the object is in the same location as the agent and that the action is 'use <tool> on <object>', not 'use <tool>'. If the object is not in the same location, move to the object's location before applying the tool.
[vc-00034] Before using a tool on an object for the purpose of 'examining with', verify that the correct instance of the object (e.g., 'pillow 1' or 'pillow 2') is being targeted in the 'use <tool> on <object>' command. If multiple instances exist, ensure the correct one is specified in the task or chosen based on visibility and accessibility.
[vc-00035] Before using a tool for the purpose of 'examining an object with the tool', verify that the action is 'use <tool> on <object>' and not 'use <tool>' in isolation. If the tool is being activated without referencing the object, adjust the action to directly apply the tool to the object.
[vc-00036] Before using a tool that requires activation (e.g., a desklamp) for the purpose of 'examining an object with the tool', verify that the action is 'use <tool> on <object>' and that the object is in the correct spatial position. If the tool is being activated in isolation (e.g., 'use <tool>'), adjust the action to directly apply the tool to the object (e.g., 'use <tool> on <object>') to ensure the task is fulfilled efficiently.
[vc-00037] Before using a tool for the purpose of 'looking at <object> under <tool>', verify that the object is already in the correct spatial position (e.g., 'under the desklamp') and both the object and the tool are visible and accessible. If so, perform 'use <tool> on <object>' immediately instead of activating the tool in isolation.
[vc-00038] Before using a tool for the purpose of 'looking at <object> under <tool>', verify that the object is already in the correct spatial position (e.g., 'under the desklamp') and that the action is 'use <tool> on <object>', not 'use <tool>'. If the tool is being activated in isolation, adjust the action to directly apply the tool to the object.
[vc-00039] Before taking an object for the purpose of 'looking at <object> under <tool>', verify that the object is not already in the correct spatial position (e.g., 'under the desklamp') and visible. If so, do not take the object and instead apply the tool directly to it.
